description:
Vital Recorder is open with case 0002.vital loaded, showing a ~4-hour 22-minute intraoperative recording from a noncardiac surgery at Seoul National University Hospital (VitalDB open dataset). The track window displays ECG leads (ECG_II, ECG_V5), pulse oximetry (PLETH), heart rate (HR), ST segment analysis (ST_V5), oxygen saturation (PLETH_SPO2), pulse-derived heart rate (PLETH_HR), ventilator respiratory rate (VENT_RR), and minute ventilation (VENT_MV). The events panel shows four surgical milestones with their timestamps.

As an anesthesiologist assistant completing post-operative documentation, you need to:
1. Export the complete vital signs recording to CSV format, saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_0002_vitals.csv
2. Create a structured anesthetic summary document saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\anesthetic_summary_0002.txt

The anesthetic summary should include:
- Case identification (case number 0002)
- Total recording duration and surgical duration (from Surgery started to Surgery finished events)
- List of all monitored physiological parameters
- A brief clinical narrative summarizing the monitoring data and any observations about the vital signs patterns during the case

Login: Desktop user (no login required).
